{\n752\t            // clap handles --help automatically, exiting before this point\n753\t            // If we reach here, it means no valid flag was provided\n754\t            return Err(anyhow!(\"No command provided. }\n764\t\n765\t    // All other commands require existing .beads directory\n766\t    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(&workspace)\n767\t        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n768\t\n769\t    match command {\n770\t        Commands::Create {\n771\t            title,\n772\t            type_,\n773\t            priority,\n774\t // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n        list_all_with_archives(beads_dir)?\n    } else {\n        // Only from database\n        let mut filter = IssueFilter::default();\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            filter.status = Some(Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            filter.issue_type =\n                Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| {\n                i.annotations\n                    .get(key)\n                    .map_or(false, |v| v == value)\n            });\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n    print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn let Some(child_id) = &result.id {\n                    println!(\"Created child: {}\", child_id);\n                }\n            }\n            println!(\n                \"Parent bead {} closed with {} children\",\n                id,\n                results.len() - 2\n            ); // -2 for close + last dep\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Format and print a dependency tree.\nfn print_dep_tree(nodes: &[crate::storage::DepTreeNode], _storage: &Storage) -> Result<()> {\n    if nodes.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"  (no dependencies)\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Status indicators: ●=open, ◐=in_progress, ○=closed/blocked/deferred, ⊘=tombstone\n    let status_symbol = |status: &str| -> char {\n        match status {\n            \"open\" => '●',\n            \"in_progress\" => '◐',\n            \"closed\" => '○',\n            \"blocked\" => '◌',\n            \"deferred\" => '○',\n            \"tombstone\" => '⊘',\n            _ => '○',\n        }\n    };\n\n    for (i, node) in nodes.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_cycle = node.path.contains(\"[CYCLE]\");\n\n        // Build tree prefix with proper branching\n        let mut prefix = String::new();\n        if node.depth > 0 {\n            for d in 0..node.depth as usize {\n                if d < node.depth as usize - 1 {\n                    prefix.push_str(\"│   \");\n                } else {\n                    // Check if this is the last node at this depth\n                    let is_last = nodes\n                        .iter()\n                        .skip(i + 1)\n                        .all(|n| n.depth < node.depth || (n.depth == node.depth && n.id > node.id));\n                    if is_last {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"└── \");\n                    } else {\n                        prefix.push_str(\"├── \");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Truncate title if too long\n        let title = if node.title.len() > 60 {\n            format!(\"{}...\", &node.title[..57])\n        } else {\n            node.title.clone()\n        };\n\n        let cycle_mark = if is_cycle { \" [CYCLE]\" } else { \"\" };\n        let dep_type_str = node.dep_type.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"blocks\");\n\n        println!(\n            \"{}[{}] {} {} (P{}, {}){}\",\n            prefix,\n            node.id,\n            status_symbol(&node.status),\n            title,\n            node.priority,\n            dep_type_str,\n            cycle_mark\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_dep(beads_dir: &PathBuf, dep: DepCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match dep {\n        DepCommands::Add {\n            blocks,\n            blocker,\n            type_,\n        } => {\n            let blocks = blocks.ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"Missing --blocks argument. Usage: bf dep add <blocker> --blocks <blocked>\"))?;\n\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let dep_type =\n                crate::model::DependencyType::from_str(&type_).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n\n            // Add the dependency: blocks depends on blocker\n            storage.add_dependency(&blocks, &blocker, &dep_type, \"cli\")?;\n\n            // If this is a blocker dependency, update status to 'blocked'\n            if matches!(dep_type, crate::model::DependencyType::Blocks) {\n                let changes = IssueChanges {\n                    status: Some(Status::Blocked),\n                    ..Default::default()\n                };\n                storage.update_issue(&blocks, &changes)?;\n            }\n\n            println!(\n                \"Added dependency: {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                blocks, blocker, type_\n            );\n        }\n        DepCommands::Remove { issue, depends_on } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            storage.remove_dependency(&issue, &depends_on)?;\n            println!(\"Removed dependency: {} -> {}\", issue, depends_on);\n        }\n        DepCommands::List { id } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let deps = storage.get_dependencies(&id)?;\n            if deps.is_empty() {\n                println!(\"No dependencies found for {}\", id);\n            } else {\n                for dep in deps {\n                    println!(\n                        \"  {} depends on {} ({})\",\n                        dep.issue_id, dep.depends_on_id, dep.dep_type\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        DepCommands::Tree {\n            id,\n            direction,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n\n            // Validate direction\n            let direction = match direction.as_str() {\n                \"down\" | \"up\" | \"both\" => direction.as_str(),\n                _ => {\n                    return Err(anyhow!(\n                        \"Invalid direction: {}. Use 'down', 'up', or 'both'\",\n                        direction\n                    ))\n                }\n            };\n\n            if format == \"json\" {\n                // JSON output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"downward\": down_nodes,\n                        \"upward\": up_nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    let output = serde_json::json!({\n                        \"root_id\": id,\n                        \"direction\": direction,\n                        \"max_depth\": max_depth,\n                        \"nodes\": nodes\n                    });\n                    println!(\"{}\", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&output)?);\n                }\n            } else {\n                // Text output format\n                if direction == \"both\" {\n                    // Show both directions separately\n                    println!(\n                        \"Dependency tree for {} (downward - what this depends on):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let down_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"down\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&down_nodes, &storage)?;\n\n                    if !down_nodes.is_empty() {\n                        println!();\n                    }\n\n                    println!(\n                        \"Reverse dependency tree for {} (upward - what depends on this):\\n\",\n                        id\n                    );\n                    let up_nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, \"up\", max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&up_nodes, &storage)?;\n                } else {\n                    let nodes = storage.get_dep_tree(&id, direction, max_depth)?;\n                    print_dep_tree(&nodes, &storage)?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_label(beads_dir: &PathBuf, label: LabelCommands) -> Result<()> {\n    match label {\n Edge Cases Catalog\n215\t\n216\t### 3.1 String Edge Cases\n217\t\n218\t| Case | Input | Expected Behavior |\n219\t|------|-------|------------------|\n220\t| Empty string | `\"\"` | Stored as-is, serialized as `\"\"` |\n221\t| Whitespace only | `\"   \"` | Stored as-is, trimmed on display? |\n235\t\n236\t### 3.2 Numeric Edge Cases\n237\t\n238\t| Case | Input | Expected Behavior |\n239\t|------|-------|------------------|\n240\t| Zero priority | `0` | Valid (P0 Critical) |\n241\t| Min priority | `0` | Valid (P0) |\n242\t| Max priority | `4` | Valid (P4 Backlog) |\n243\t| Underflow min | `-1` | **Reject** with error |\n244\t| Overflow max | `5` | **Reject** with error |\n245\t| Negative estimated | `-60` | **Reject** or allow? |\n246\t| Zero estimated | `0` | Valid (no estimate) |\n247\t| Large estimated | `999999` | Valid (16,666 hours) |\n248\t\n249\t### 3.3 DateTime Edge Cases\n250\t\n251\t| Case | Input | Expected Behavior |\n252\t|------|-------|------------------|\n253\t| Unix epoch | `1970-01-01T00:00:00Z` | Valid |\n254\t| Far future | `2100-01-01T00:00:00Z` | Valid |\n255\t| Microseconds | `2026-01-01T12:00:00.123456Z` | Truncate to milliseconds? |\n256\t| Monotonic | `created_at == updated_at` | Valid |\n257\t| Out of order | `closed_at < created_at` | **Reject** or allow? |\n258\t| Timezone | `2026-01-01T12:00:00+05:00` | Convert to UTC |\n259\t\n260\t### 3.4 Enum Edge Cases\n261\t\n262\t| Case | Input | Expected Behavior |\n263\t|------|-------|------------------|\n264\t| Custom status | `Status::Custom(\"any-string\")` | Valid, roundtrips |\n265\t| Custom type | `IssueType::Custom(\"spike\")` | Valid, roundtrips |\n266\t| Custom dep type | `DependencyType::Custom(\"related-to\")` | Valid, roundtrips |\n267\t| Empty custom | `Custom(\"\")` | Valid? It is a drop-in replacement for `br` — every command, flag, and output format is identical — with one critical improvement: **concurrent claiming is correct**.\n6\t\n7\t---\n8\t\n9\t## The Problem It Solves\n10\t\n11\t`br` has a race condition at its core. Claiming a bead requires two separate operations:\n12\t\n13\t```\n14\tbr ready --json          # read candidates (snapshot)\n15\t  ↓  (race window)\n16\tbr update <id> --status in_progress --assignee <worker>\n17\t  ↓  (race window)\n18\tbr show <id>             # verify the claim stuck\n19\t```\n20\t\n21\tWith 20 NEEDLE workers running simultaneously, multiple workers read the same candidate list, all select the same top bead, and all issue `br update`. SQLite last-writer-wins — 19 workers hold phantom claims on beads they don't actually own.\n22\t\n23\t`bf` eliminates this with a single `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` SQLite transaction:\n24\t\n25\t```\n26\tbf claim --assignee worker-7 --model claude-sonnet-4-6 --harness needle --json\n27\t```\n28\t\n29\tThe entire read-score-update sequence runs inside one write lock. No two workers can observe the same candidate state.\n30\t\n31\t---\n32\t\n33\t## Architecture\n34\t\n35\t```\n36\tSQLite (live store)                    issues.jsonl (git artifact)\n37\t    │                                        │\n38\t    │  all reads and writes                  │  exported by bf sync --flush\n39\t    │                                        │  imported by bf sync --import\n40\t    ▼                                        ▼\n41\t  beads.db                            .beads/issues.jsonl\n42\t  (gitignored)                        (committed to git)\n43\t```\n44\t\n45\t**SQLite is the live database.** JSONL is a derived snapshot committed to git for backup, cross-machine sharing, and recovery. `beads.db` is rebuilt at any time with `bf doctor --repair`.\n46\t\n47\t**No daemon. No server. No flock.** Each `bf` invocation is self-contained: open DB, acquire write lock, execute, release, exit. SQLite WAL mode enables concurrent reads during writes.\n48\t\n49\t---\n50\t\n51\t## Key Features\n52\t\n53\t### Atomic Concurrent Claiming\n54\t\n55\t```\n56\tWorker 1: BEGIN IMMEDIATE → SELECT + score → UPDATE winner → COMMIT\n57\tWorker 2: BEGIN IMMEDIATE → (blocked until Worker 1 commits) → SELECT → ...\n58\t...\n59\tWorker 20: BEGIN IMMEDIATE → SELECT → NONE (queue empty) → COMMIT\n60\t```\n61\t\n62\tThe entire claim pipeline — stale reclamation, candidate scoring, winner selection, status update, event recording — runs in a single SQLite write transaction. Guaranteed correct under any concurrency level.\n63\t\n64\t### Critical Path Scoring\n65\t\n66\t`bf` computes the **float** of each bead: how many hops it can slip before delaying its epic. Beads on the critical path (`float == 0`) receive a 1000-point bonus in the claim scorer, ensuring the fleet works on the most impactful beads automatically — without human priority curation.\n67\t\n68\t```\n69\t$ bf critical-path bf-epic-123\n70\t\n71\t  float=0  [bf-a3f8] Implement auth token refresh        in_progress\n72\t  float=0  [bf-b2c1] Fix concurrent session state bug    open\n73\t  float=2  [bf-d5e3] Update API documentation            open\n74\t```\n75\t\n76\t### Velocity-Aware Scoring\n77\t\n78\tWorkers declare their composition when claiming:\n79\t\n80\t```bash\n81\tbf claim --assignee worker-7 \\\n82\t         --model claude-sonnet-4-6 \\\n83\t         --harness needle \\\n84\t         --harness-version 0.5.2 \\\n85\t         --json\n86\t```\n87\t\n88\t`bf` tracks close times per `(model, harness, issue_type)` in `velocity_stats`. The claim scorer weights candidates by `impact / expected_duration` — the fleet maximizes throughput per unit time, not just raw priority. After 10+ completions per cohort, routing becomes measurably smarter.\n89\t\n90\t```\n91\t$ bf velocity\n92\t\n93\tModel                  Harness   Type     Samples  p50    p90\n94\tclaude-opus-4-7        needle    task     142      8m     22m\n95\tclaude-sonnet-4-6      needle    task     87       18m    45m\n96\tclaude-haiku-4-5       needle    task     23       35m    2h10m\n97\t```\n98\t\n99\t### Atomic Batch Operations\n100\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":"call_b4b3e17ea5c94af3a4e091da","session_id":"14ae1e5e-87ad-4c9b-baee-a7a636124d93","uuid":"378472b2-608e-4c3c-85e4-3a7b3deb99fb","timestamp":"2026-07-06T15:27:14.436Z","subagent_type":"Explore","task_description":"Explore label system implementation"}
